general_sources.title: Prime Minister begins Middle East visits
general_sources.text: Lawrence Wong visits Qatar on 18–20 October and the UAE on 20–22 October, his first visits to the Middle East as Prime Minister. Energy security and economic resilience are on the agenda.

general_sources.title: At least 17 reported dead at Kolkata Durga Puja pandal
general_sources.text: The Indian Express reports at least 17 deaths at the Chorebagan Sarbojanin Durga Puja pandal, with several people injured. Injury figures vary; the cause and responsibility should not be treated as established.

general_sources.title: Zelensky urges support for US sanctions
general_sources.text: AP reports that Volodymyr Zelensky urged support for US sanctions after Donald Trump signed an order putting the new restrictions on hold. This is a fresh development in the existing diplomatic dispute.

general_sources.title: India–West Indies T20I series finishes 2–2
general_sources.text: The final T20I was abandoned after 46 balls, leaving the series level at 2–2.

general_sources.title: Rafael Jodar reaches first Masters 1000 final
general_sources.text: Jodar beat Daniil Medvedev 6–3, 6–4 in Shanghai. He will face Alejandro Davidovich Fokina in his first Masters 1000 final.
